messages:
maria (Docs): heads up — mkdocs linkcheck failing for /guides/migrate#configuration, CI on buildkite
jonathan (Platform): saw that, looks like we removed the 'Configuration' H2 in migration.md during the reorg
maria (Docs): exact. old link from /reference/notes still points to #configuration
sam (Eng): can we add an explicit anchor? md supports HTML or heading id. e.g.
```md
## Configuration {#configuration}
```
maria (Docs): alternatively update the link to use the new slug (configuring-the-migration) — but easier to add anchor
jonathan (Platform): I'll open a tiny PR to add id and update redirects in mkdocs.yml for older paths, pinging @docs-reviewers
buildkite (CI): build #1247 failed — mkdocs-linkcheck: 1 broken fragment: /guides/migrate#configuration
maria (Docs): thanks. FYI mkdocs-linkcheck flags fragments that don't have an exact match; it won't follow anchor redirects. we need explicit id for backward compatibility
sam (Eng): PR 4321 opened: add explicit id + e2e linkcheck fix. @maria can you review?
maria (Docs): reviewing now, also adding a note in the migration guide about the heading rename so folks searching won't be surprised
linkcheck-bot: re-check scheduled in 10m :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria (Docs): once merged, I'll trigger the buildkite job and close the related doc issue
